BETA Close X Currys Plc has announced the purchase of 607,384 of its own ordinary shares for cancellation between July 14 and July 20, 2026, at prices ranging from 159.20p to 162.00p per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 1,092,602,386, with no shares held in treasury. This updated figure serves as the denominator for shareholders calculating their notification requirements under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
